description: Find open times for one service at a business, up to 14 days. Each time comes with a booking_url that opens the business's booking page with the service, professional and time already chosen; give that link to the person to confirm with their name and phone.

business.description: The business id returned by find_business.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the location's timezone. Defaults to today.

location_id.description: Location id. Defaults to the first location.

staff_id.description: Only this professional. Leave out for anyone available.

start_time_before.description: Optional latest start time, exclusive, HH:MM (24-hour) in the location timezone on every searched day. Must be later than start_time_from if both are given. Filters appointment starts, not end times.

start_time_from.description: Optional earliest start time, inclusive, HH:MM (24-hour) in the location timezone on every searched day. For afternoon use 12:00.

through.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 13 days after from. Defaults to a week.

name: find_slots
title: Find open times
